name: Sai Silks (Kalamandir) Ltd
title: Sai Silks (Kalamandir) Ltd - 543989 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Sai Silks FY26 revenue up 13.1% to INR1,654 crore with SSSG only +3% and Q4 growth slowing to 5.1%; FY27 target ~1 lakh sq ft retail addition, EBITDA guided to 17.5–18% from 15.76%.

triggers.label: Q4 revenue growth 5.1% YoY
triggers.quote: We delivered a revenue of about INR419 crores, representing a growth of 5.1% Y -o-Y despite a relatively mixed consumption environment

triggers.label: FY26 SSSG only +3%
triggers.quote: while the same-store sales growth stood at plus 3%
triggers.highlight: same-store sales growth stood at plus 3%

triggers.label: EBITDA target 17.5–18% FY27
triggers.quote: we should at least be in the 17.5% to 18% range this year

triggers.label: ~1 lakh sq ft FY27 additions, ~20% above FY26
triggers.quote: the net square feet addition in this year will be in the range of 100,000

triggers.label: Inventory days ~180, no target
triggers.quote: How much , because 180 days was the last year's inventory days, which is still too high. So, any target here?
triggers.highlight: 180 days was the last year's inventory days

guidance.value: ~100,000 sq ft net, possibly more after H1
guidance.quote: the net square feet addition in this year will be in the range of 100,000

guidance.value: similar to a little bit better than FY26 (>3%)
guidance.quote: we do anticipate a similar to a little bit better SSSG numbers than we've achieved this year
we should at least be in the 17.5% to 18% range this year
we should be able to expect a decent EBITDA about the full year EBITDA plus at least 50 basis points in the next year
we have budget on the advertisement side to still be able to run at 4% kind of a number only

prior_guidance_check.metric: EBITDA improvement ~200 bps per year (~19% by FY27)
prior_guidance_check.quote: The target would be the same. This year, we have reached about 16-point-odd.

red_flags.label: Q4 SSSG and growth slowdown; Telangana KLM decline
red_flags.quote: Telangana has been a slower growth, and this is majorly on account of KLM.

red_flags.label: Inventory days ~180, no target; inventory per sq ft down only modestly
red_flags.quote: So that's a concerted effort, but we have to get an equilibrium between the inventory days and the sale achievements

red_flags.label: Tax demand on promoter group settled; governance questions
red_flags.quote: The contention on which they have raised the demand on personal taxation of promoter group was wrong.

evasions.quote: it will be difficult for me to give you a revenue guidance right now
Normally, format-wise sales are something that dissemination of the information is detrimental to the interest of the company.
if I convey a KPI on this within the system, then it is taking a negative toll on the sales part
the specific mathematics we will discuss in the Q2 call
